scenes.name: ICE CAPS
lines: Push an axis through a ball. Paint every point within forty-five degrees of either end.
让一根轴穿过球心，把离两端不到 45° 的点都涂上色。
You get two polar ice caps. Call the pair one color.
这就得到南北两块冰盖；这一对，算一种颜色。
Inside one cap, two points are less than ninety degrees apart. Across the caps, more than ninety.
同一块冰盖里，两点夹角不到 90°；分处两块，夹角超过 90°。
So one color never holds a right angle, the blind spot of comparison. How many colors cover the ball?
所以一种颜色里永远凑不出直角，那正是比较的盲点。盖满整颗球，要几种颜色？

scenes.name: THREE LEAK
lines: The obvious try: the three coordinate axes, three pairs of caps.
最顺手的办法：三根坐标轴，三对冰盖。
Walk out along the diagonal, toward one, one, one.
沿着对角线往 (1, 1, 1) 的方向走。
Its overlap with each axis, squared, is one third. A cap needs more than one half.
它和每根轴的内积平方都是 1/3；进冰盖却要大于 1/2。
Holes open around all eight diagonals. The leak is in the frame we chose, not in the ball.
八条对角线周围都漏出了洞。漏缝出在我们挑的坐标架上，不在球上。

scenes.name: SIX COVER
lines: So split each axis in two, and swing the halves apart like opening scissors.
那就把每根轴劈成两根，像张开剪刀一样往两边转。
The holes close early. We stop where the axes become whole numbers, like one, two, zero.
洞很早就合上了；我们停在轴变成整数的地方，比如 (1, 2, 0)。
Back on the diagonal, the squared overlap is three. Divide by five: three fifths, more than one half.
回到对角线：内积平方是 3，除以 5 得 3/5，大于 1/2。
Lean checks these six colors: six open colors, no right angle inside any, and together they cover the sphere.
Lean 内核检验了这六种颜色：都是开集，每种里都没有直角，合起来盖满球面。

scenes.name: WHY NOT FIVE
lines: Could five do it? Take a point. The circle at right angles to it must avoid every color holding the point.
五种行不行？取一个点。和它成直角的那一圈，必须躲开所有含这个点的颜色。
This point sits in colors zero, two and four. Its circle runs through one, three and five.
这个点在 0、2、4 号颜色里；它的直角圈只经过 1、3、5 号。
Even a circle needs three right-angle-free colors. So every point misses at least three.
连一个圆，没有直角的颜色也要三种才盖得住。所以每个点至少缺三种。
Picture countries on a globe, none big enough to wrap it. They cannot meet only in pairs; somewhere, three overlap.
地球仪上的国家都绕不了球一圈，它们没法只两两相邻，总有一处三国重叠。
Three present, three missing: six. Lean checks it: every such cover needs at least six colors.
三种在，三种缺，合起来是六。Lean 内核检验：这样的覆盖至少要六种颜色。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Six is the fewest. It is not the only way: other axes work too.
六是最少；但不是唯一的办法，别的轴也行。
This is about patches free of right angles, not about combing a hairy ball.
这里讲的是没有直角的开块，不是给毛球梳毛。
The six axes settle the upper half of a question by Feldman and Wilce; antipodal coverings like it are classical. The book claims no discovery.
六轴只给出 Feldman–Wilce 问题 3 的上界，这类覆盖早有先例，本书不争首创。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter nine.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第九章
